newsitem.title: USA: Florida Progress active on ex-dividend date. [CORRECTED 22:40 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Florida Progress active on ex-dividend date. [CORRECTED 22:40 GMT]

text.p: Shares of Florida Progress Corp were among the most active issues on the New York Stock Exchange on Wednesday.
The shares were off 1/8 to 32-3/8 in heavy trading, with more than two million shares changing hands.

The company's ex-dividend date is today, meaning that investors buying the stock are no longer entitled to the quarterly dividend payout of $0.515 a share on December 20. (Corrects meaning of ex-dividend date)
